description: Admin foundation: Sanity user-authenticated client + auth gate for a protected /admin area, a WordPress/Studio-style admin shell layout, and shared Portable Text (de)serialization utilities. This lays the groundwork every later feature builds on. Establishes the auth mechanism (logged-in Sanity user, no master token) and the exact block/mark/list/table shapes the editor produces and consumes.
steps: Create lib/sanity-admin.ts exporting a browser-usable Sanity client for authenticated writes AS THE LOGGED-IN USER. Use createClient from '@sanity/client' (already a dep) with { projectId: NEXT_PUBLIC_SANITY_PROJECT_ID||'h0xv92n1', dataset: NEXT_PUBLIC_SANITY_DATASET||'production', apiVersion: '2024-01-01', useCdn: false, withCredentials: true }. withCredentials makes the browser send the Sanity session cookie so mutations/uploads run under the user's own roles. Export a helper getCurrentUser() that calls client.request({ url: '/users/me' }) and returns the user JSON or null on 401/error. Export the Sanity hosted login URL builder: `https://<projectId>.api.sanity.io/v1/auth/login/<provider>?origin=<encoded app origin>` and a logout helper (client.request({ url: '/auth/logout', method: 'POST' })). Do NOT read or use any SANITY write TOKEN env var here; identity must come from the user session. Keep lib/sanity.ts (read client, useCdn:true) untouched.

Create components/admin/AdminAuthGate.tsx ('use client'): on mount, call getCurrentUser(); while loading show a centered spinner/skeleton; if authenticated, render children and expose the user (name/email) to the shell; if NOT authenticated, render a login screen with a 'Sign in with Sanity' button that redirects to the Sanity login URL (origin = window.location.origin, return to /admin). Provide the user via React context (AdminUserContext) so the shell header can show the current user and a Sign out action.

Create app/admin/layout.tsx: a dedicated layout mirroring app/studio/layout.tsx conventions - metadata robots:{index:false,follow:false} (never index the admin), full-viewport, and it must NOT render the public Header/Footer. Wrap children in AdminAuthGate. Use Tailwind design tokens (paper/surface/ink/hairline/accent) so the look matches the site + resembles Studio: a left sidebar (brand 'Coinscribed Admin', nav links: Articles, New Article) + a top bar (current user + Sign out) + a main content pane. Build a components/admin/AdminShell.tsx client component for the sidebar/topbar chrome.

Create app/admin/page.tsx = the dashboard/article list. Client component that uses the admin client to fetch articles for editing via GROQ: `*[_type=='article']|order(_updatedAt desc){_id, title, 'slug': slug.current, publishedAt, _updatedAt, 'category': category->title, 'author': author->name}`. Also fetch drafts (ids starting with 'drafts.') so both draft and published articles show with a status badge (Draft vs Published). Render a Studio-like list/table with title, status, category, author, last-updated, and 'Edit' links to /admin/articles/[id]/edit, plus a prominent 'New Article' button linking to /admin/articles/new. Handle empty state.

Create lib/portable-text.ts with pure, dependency-free helpers used by the editor to build Sanity-compatible content. Include: genKey() (short random string for _key, e.g. 12 hex chars); functions to build a Portable Text block matching data/sample-news.ts exactly: { _key, _type:'block', style:'normal'|'h2'|'h3'|'h4'|'blockquote', markDefs:[], children:[{_key,_type:'span',text,marks:[]}] }, list blocks adding listItem:'bullet'|'number' and level:1, spans with marks arrays for strong/em/underline/code, and link annotations stored in markDefs as {_key,_type:'link',href} with the span's marks referencing that markDef _key; a buildTableBlock(caption, header, rows) => { _key, _type:'tableBlock', caption?, header:string[], rows:[{_key,_type:'row', cells:string[]}] } EXACTLY matching sanity/schemas/tableBlock.ts and the TableValue in PortableTextRenderer.tsx; and the inverse parsers (Portable Text -> editor model) so the edit screen can load existing article bodies. Add TypeScript types for the editor's internal document model. Reference lib/sanity-queries.ts PortableTextBlock interface for field names.

Add types/an interface for the admin article draft model in lib/portable-text.ts or a new lib/admin-types.ts: title, slug, excerpt, bodyModel, authorRef, categoryRef, publishedAt, mainImage(asset ref+alt), seoTitle, seoDescription, faqs[{question,answer}] - mirroring sanity/schemas/article.ts field names and validation limits (excerpt<=300, seoTitle<=70, seoDescription<=160).
acceptance_criteria: lib/sanity-admin.ts exports a client configured with withCredentials:true and useCdn:false and NEVER references a write token env var; getCurrentUser() hits /users/me.

Visiting /admin while unauthenticated shows a 'Sign in with Sanity' screen that redirects to https://<projectId>.api.sanity.io/v1/auth/login/... with the correct origin; authenticated users see the dashboard.
app/admin/layout.tsx sets robots noindex/nofollow and does not render the public Header/Footer; /studio route and files are completely unchanged.
app/admin/page.tsx lists existing articles (published + drafts) with a Draft/Published status badge and Edit links, using the authenticated client.

lib/portable-text.ts buildTableBlock produces exactly {_type:'tableBlock', caption?, header:string[], rows:[{_type:'row', cells:string[]}]} with _key on block and each row; block/span builders match data/sample-news.ts shape (verified by reading both).
No new npm dependency is added (only @sanity/client already present); if one is truly required it is added to BOTH package.json and package-lock.json.
verification: Static review: confirm every import resolves to a dependency present in package.json and to files that exist; confirm 'use client' is present on all interactive components.

Diff lib/portable-text.ts buildTableBlock/block builders against sanity/schemas/tableBlock.ts, sanity/schemas/article.ts, components/news/PortableTextRenderer.tsx, and data/sample-news.ts and confirm field names/shape match exactly.
Confirm lib/sanity.ts is unchanged and /studio files are unchanged (git diff).

Rely on GitHub Actions CI (npm ci && next build && next lint) for the authoritative compile/lint pass; ensure code is written to pass it (no unused vars, no unescaped JSX entities, next/image or explicit eslint-disable for ).
findings: Implemented additively; lib/sanity.ts, app/studio/*, and sanity/schemas/* are all unchanged (git status confirms only new files). Delivered: lib/sanity-admin.ts (browser client withCredentials:true+useCdn:false, NO token; getCurrentUser hits /users/me, getLoginUrl builds https://<projectId>.api.sanity.io/v1/auth/login/<provider>?origin=..., logout POSTs /auth/logout), lib/admin-types.ts (ArticleDraft editor model + ARTICLE_LIMITS mirroring article.ts validation: excerpt<=300/seoTitle<=70/seoDescription<=160/slug<=96 + AdminArticleListItem), lib/portable-text.ts (genKey, buildSpan/buildLink/buildBlock/buildTextBlock matching data/sample-news.ts, buildTableBlock EXACTLY matching tableBlock.ts {_key,_type:'tableBlock',caption?,header:string[],rows:[{_key,_type:'row',cells:string[]}]}, plus serializeBody/parseBody inverse parsers), components/admin/AdminUserContext.tsx + AdminAuthGate.tsx ('Sign in with Sanity' -> hosted login, loading spinner, context), components/admin/AdminShell.tsx (Studio-like sidebar+topbar with Sign out), app/admin/layout.tsx (robots noindex/nofollow, no public Header/Footer), app/admin/page.tsx (authed GROQ list incl drafts, collapses draft+published pairs, Draft/Published badges, Edit links to /admin/articles/[id]/edit, New Article button, empty state). ENV CONSTRAINT: could NOT run next build/lint locally (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY, node_modules incomplete, @sanity/client folder absent) - verified statically against real types; rely on GitHub Actions CI for authoritative build. Removed redundant per-request withCredentials from client.request calls since the client is already configured with withCredentials:true (avoids possible RequestOptions type mismatch). AUTH NOTE for later features: requires 'Allow credentials' CHECKED on CORS origins in manage.sanity.io for credentialed writes; getLoginUrl defaults provider to 'google'. No new npm dependency added.
